about: Moving heads as their light looks at night: strong where the beam is narrow and soft where it is wide, fading gently to the end of its reach; a head dimmed to a third, fainter in the same hue, its flare smaller and less white; one whose zoom channel widens its beam; one hung high pointing straight down, stopping at the ground in a flat pool, and one slanting down onto it, its pool stretched; one leaning toward the viewer, brighter for being seen along it, its far end a soft disc; and one whose shutter is shut, dark, with no beam or flare.
